coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of eight ground-truth variable items match: consistent evaluation using R², an 80% development/training and 20% test split, and the 26 car-design parameters. Training sizes and model architectures overlap only partially, giving 38% under item-level matching.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The fixed CSV path is omitted. Training fractions omit 60% and 80% and introduce other levels. AutoGluon and a distinct GradientBoosting model are missing, while unrelated architectures are added. Morphological subgroup analysis does not reproduce the Fastback-only versus combined-dataset comparison. The output prioritizes RMSE and uses 10 replicas rather than average R² with confidence intervals over 20 splits.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected improvement with increasing training size and the model-specific findings that AutoGluon performs well in the single-design scenario while LightGBM excels on the combined dataset.
